detail: 90 readings reported in order with correct temperatures
finalText:
Done. The board now runs the fixed firmware and verifies clean.

## Root cause

The queue was created to hold **pointers**:

```c
static QueueHandle_t readings;
...
readings = xQueueCreate(QUEUE_LEN, sizeof(char *));
...
char line[48];               // one buffer, allocated once
...
snprintf(line, ... "<seq/temp>" ...);
char *msg = line;            // always the SAME address
xQueueSend(readings, &msg, ...);   // enqueues the pointer, not the text
```

`sensor_task` reused the **single stack buffer `line`** for every reading, so all 5 queue entries in a burst held the same pointer. The reporter is slower (30 ms per report), so by the time it read each entry the sensor had already overwritten the buffer with the *last* reading of the burst. Result: every burst printed 5 identical lines carrying only the last seq/temp (seq=4 ×5, seq=9 ×5, …), and readings 0–3, 5–8, … were never observable. There was no "dropped" warning because the *sends* all succeeded — the queue entries existed, they just all aliased one buffer.

Reproduced deterministically on a clean build of the original source (`seq=4`/`seq=9`/`seq=14` each ×5).

## Fix (`main/main.c`)

Queued the reading **by value** instead of by pointer, so each entry owns its own data:

```c
typedef struct { uint32_t seq; int temp_centi; } reading_t;
...
readings = xQueueCreate(QUEUE_LEN, sizeof(reading_t));
...
reading_t r = { .seq = seq, .temp_centi = fake_temperature(seq) };
xQueueSend(readings, &r, pdMS_TO_TICKS(10));
...
if (xQueueReceive(readings, &r, portMAX_DELAY)) {
    vTaskDelay(pdMS_TO_TICKS(30));
    printf("report seq=%" PRIu32 " temp=%d.%02d\n", r.seq, r.temp_centi/100, r.temp_centi%100);
}
```

Kept the exact `report seq=<n> temp=<t>` format, `FIFO_BURST 5`, `BURST_INTERVAL_MS 500`, and `QUEUE_LEN 4`.

## Verification (on hardware)

Clean build + flash, then serial captured 120+ reports:
- seq 0,1,2,… strictly in order, no gaps or duplicates
- every temperature matches `fake_temperature(seq)` exactly
- no drops / no "queue full" warnings
